newsitem.title: USA: NABI says HIV-IG trial to continue.
newsitem.headline: NABI says HIV-IG trial to continue.

text.p: NABI Inc on Tuesday said the National Institutes of Health would continue a Phase III trial of HIV-IG, following an interim efficacy review made by an independent data and safety monitoring board.
HIV-IG is NABI's immunotherapeutic product in development for the prevention of HIV transmission from mother to infant. It is currently in a Phase III randomized, double-blind, controlled study.
NABI said in a release that no safety problems were reported in the interim review, and it would provide additional data in the coming weeks.
